title: Transfer build-system hermeticity to reproducible agent runs
question: What does a hermetic build guarantee, what does it cost, and which hermeticity properties can an agent run adopt given that its inputs include a live model and a live web - a question the estate's own hermetic-probe experience makes concrete?
canonical_mechanism: Declare every input, including network destinations; ignore comments; pin what can be pinned; treat warm cache as an input. Do not claim Lamb Definition 1 over a live model and a live web.

property_list.name: No undeclared egress: every destination is declared or the run is a violation
property_list.guarantee_from_builds: Bazel linux-sandbox may isolate the network namespace; undeclared inputs (files or network) are exactly what sandboxing exists to make fail. Lamb's uncontrolled-build-inputs class is the same defect without a sandbox.
property_list.how_an_agent_run_adopts: Run with egress blocked or traced. Record attempted destinations. A comment that says 'never downloads' is not evidence. A deliberate control fetch must fail while the block is on.
property_list.cost: Declared WebSearch/WebFetch must be allowlisted; tests that silently bootstrap pip fail closed instead of going green.

property_list.name: Comments and docstrings asserting offline never classify a run as hermetic
property_list.guarantee_from_builds: A jail or sandbox, not a comment in the BUILD file, is what hides the host. CNF-0106 lying comment is the estate instance.
property_list.how_an_agent_run_adopts: The blocked run plus destination list is the evidence. This is a supporting rule of P-UNDECLARED-EGRESS, not a second detector.
property_list.cost: Documentation cannot substitute for the harness.

property_list.name: Record pinned tool versions, prompt hashes, and fixture hashes (.buildinfo analogue)
property_list.guarantee_from_builds: Lamb §Recording build information: .buildinfo records source version, Installed-Build-Depends with exact versions, and checksums of artifacts. Debian hosts over 20 million such files.
property_list.how_an_agent_run_adopts: Pin CLI, plugin, and schema hashes. Live model id is recorded as an unpinned input, not as a pinned weight digest.
property_list.cost: Operational overhead of recording and reconstructing the pin set.

property_list.name: Warm caches are inputs; cold vs warm must be split
property_list.guarantee_from_builds: A warm cache that satisfies a fetch hides an undeclared network dependency. Estate catalog: cache re-verify discarded the fixture and refetched.
property_list.how_an_agent_run_adopts: Warm+blocked may pass from local bytes; cold+blocked must fail and log the destination if the bytes were a network input.
property_list.cost: Every confirmation that can hit a cache needs a cold-cache cell.

property_list.name: Two-environment rebuild on traces and pinned artifacts
property_list.guarantee_from_builds: Lamb adversarial rebuilding: clock +18 months, hostname, language, kernel, disorderfs.
property_list.how_an_agent_run_adopts: Compare tool traces and declared-input hashes across two envs. Do not require matching model tokens.
property_list.cost: Double the runs; still does not close the live-model input.

property_list.name: Closed-world bit-identity over the complete agent input set
property_list.guarantee_from_builds: The build process of a software product is reproducible if, after designating a specific version of its source code and all of its build dependencies, every build produces bit-for-bit identical artifacts, no matter the environment in which the build is performed.
property_list.how_an_agent_run_adopts: It cannot. A live model and a live web are inputs that the run does not designate as bit-identical snapshots, which is the antecedent of Definition 1.
property_list.cost: Attempting it produces a false green: two runs that 'look' similar.

silent_download_mapping.motivating_case: 14 tests silently downloaded get-pip.py from the network despite comments claiming they never download; a cache re-verify discarded the fixture and refetched
silent_download_mapping.independence_check: The three catalog sentences share one upstream estate narrative; they count as ONE signal for the headline '14', not three. CNF-0106 is a second local signal that the PATTERN (lying comment + fetch) exists on this worktree, not that the count is 14. The '14' is therefore E3 and does not promote a mechanism. It is the motivating CASE a property must map onto.
silent_download_mapping.why_it_would_have_caught: Each of the 14 tests asserted in comments that it never downloads. P-UNDECLARED-EGRESS ignores that comment and requires an egress-blocked run. The get-pip.py fetch would attempt bootstrap.pypa.io (or the mirror in use); the destination list would be non-empty; classification would be silent-download. A warm cache could mask the fetch; P-CACHE-AS-DECLARED-INPUT splits warm vs cold so the re-verify that discarded the fixture and refetched would also go red under block. That is the property that would have CAUGHT the case. A property that only reads comments would have missed it.
silent_download_mapping.counterfactual_miss: If the proposed property had been 'tests whose comments mention offline are hermetic', the 14 tests would have stayed green.

impossible_property.name: Closed-world bit-identity over the complete agent input set (Lamb Definition 1)
impossible_property.reason: Definition 1 requires designating a specific version of source AND all build dependencies. A live model is an input whose weights and sampling are not a designated bit-identical snapshot in this estate's agent runs. A live web is an input that changes underfoot. Those two inputs are in the catalog question; therefore the agent run can never satisfy closed-world bit-identity. It can still adopt declared-egress, comment-is-not-evidence, pin-what-is-pinnable, and cache-as-input.
impossible_property.lamb_definition_1: The build process of a software product is reproducible if, after designating a specific version of its source code and all of its build dependencies, every build produces bit-for-bit identical artifacts, no matter the environment in which the build is performed.

mechanisms.title: Pinned source+deps imply bit-identical artifacts (Lamb Definition 1)
mechanisms.locator: Lamb & Zacchiroli, IEEE Software 2021, section REPRODUCIBLE BUILDS, Definition 1 (verbatim)
mechanisms.verbatim: The build process of a software product is reproducible if, after designating a specific version of its source code and all of its build dependencies, every build produces bit-for-bit identical artifacts, no matter the environment in which the build is performed.
mechanisms.effect_size: bit-for-bit identical artifacts (definitional; identity, not a rate)
mechanisms.baseline: inputs restricted to a designated source version AND all build dependencies AND toolchain; environment is not an input
mechanisms.cost: jails result in slower build times and impose technical and social restrictions on developers who may be accustomed to choosing their tooling
mechanisms.cost_locator: section REPRODUCIBILITY IN THE SMALL, Uncontrolled build inputs / jails paragraph
mechanisms.transfer: An agent run can pin tools, prompts, and fixtures the way a build pins source+deps. It cannot pin a live model or live web as bit-identical inputs, so Definition 1 does not hold over the whole agent input set.

mechanisms.title: Debian-scale reproducibility is high but not total after seven years
mechanisms.locator: Lamb & Zacchiroli section REPRODUCIBILITY IN THE LARGE, paragraph 2; corroborated by reproducible-builds.org 2021-08-24 'Aiming for bullseye' slide: 29599/30896 = 95.5% CI reproducibility for bullseye
mechanisms.verbatim: Seven years later, over 95% of the 30 000+ packages in Debian's development branch can now be built reproducibly
mechanisms.effect_size: over 95% of Debian development-branch packages reproducible (Lamb); 29599 of 30896 = 95.5% bullseye CI (presentation)
mechanisms.baseline: 30 000+ packages in Debian development branch, seven years after the 2014 start (Lamb); 30896 source packages in the bullseye CI census (presentation). Remaining ~5% not yet reproducible; Lamb notes regressions in previously-reproducible packages.

second_source.locator: bullseye: 95.5% (29599 out of 30896 source packages) CI reproducibility
second_source.caveat: The same deck says '93% reproducibility is a lie' meaning CI results are not independent rebuilds from snapshot.debian.org. E2 here is two reports of a CI-style rate, not two independent rebuild campaigns.

mechanisms.transfer: Cost of the guarantee at archive scale is years of QA and still not 100%. Agent-run hermeticity should not be sold as cheaper.

mechanisms.title: Two deliberately diverged build environments detect uncontrolled inputs
mechanisms.verbatim: builds each package in the Debian archive twice in a row, using two independent build environments that are deliberately configured to differ as much as possible. For instance, the clock on the second build is set 18 months in the future
mechanisms.effect_size: 30+ environmental variations applied between the two builds (method parameter, not a detection-rate)
mechanisms.baseline: same package built twice; variations include clock (+18 months), hostname, language, kernel, and disorderfs-reversed directory order
mechanisms.transfer: Agent runs can adopt two-env rebuild on logs, tool traces, and pinned artifacts. They cannot expect model logits to match across the two envs.

mechanisms.title: Unreproducibility causes are localizable in a ranked file list
mechanisms.locator: Ren, Jiang, Xuan, Yang, ICSE 2018, Abstract and §4.2 Data Preparation; A@1 and A@10 reported in the abstract
mechanisms.verbatim: By considering the topmost ranked file only, RepLoc achieves an accuracy rate of 47.09%. If we expand our examination to the top ten ranked files in the list produced by RepLoc, the accuracy rate becomes 79.28%.
mechanisms.baseline: 671 unreproducible Debian packages in four categories with >30 packages each (Timestamps 462, File-ordering 118, Randomness 50, Locale 41), drawn from 1716 bug reports across 14 Debian reproducible-issue categories; ground truth is later BTS patches. Comparators: RepLoc(HF), RepLoc(FR), RepLoc(FR+QA); Wilcoxon signed-rank vs those variants p<0.05 on P@10 and R@10.
mechanisms.transfer: Useful for timestamp/ordering bugs. Does not detect silent network fetches; not the catching property for the 14-test case.

mechanisms.title: A majority of studied malicious packages run at install/download time
mechanisms.locator: Ohm, Plate, Sykosch, Meier, DIMVA 2020, §3 dataset construction and concluding analysis paragraph
mechanisms.verbatim: A total number of 469 malicious packages could be identified. Eventually, we were able to obtain at least one affected version for 174 packages. Manual analysis revealed that most packages (56%) trigger their malicious behavior on installation
mechanisms.effect_size: 174 packages with at least one obtainable affected version; 56% trigger malicious behavior on installation
mechanisms.baseline: 469 malicious packages identified; 59 researcher PoC excluded; download success npm 109/374 (29.14%), PyPI 28/44 (63.64%), RubyGems 37/41 (90.24%), Maven Central 0/10. Window Nov 2015–Nov 2019.
mechanisms.transfer: Automatic download-and-run is the execution point. An undeclared get-pip.py fetch is the same shape even when the bytes are not malware: the run reached the network without declaring it.

mechanisms.title: Hermetic builds make every agent run 100% bit-identical
An agent run with a live model and live web satisfies Lamb Definition 1
mechanisms.locator: inferred transfer of Definition 1 onto live APIs

answers.hermetic_build_guarantees: After pinning source + all build dependencies, every build produces bit-for-bit identical artifacts regardless of host environment (Lamb Definition 1). Undeclared inputs are a violation, not a comment.
answers.what_it_costs: Jails are slower and socially costly (Lamb). Debian spent seven years to reach >95% of 30 000+ packages and still has a residual ~5% plus regressions. Recording .buildinfo, sorting directory iteration, and SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH are the operational cost.

reviewer.job: Fresh-context refuter. Default REFUTED where evidence is insufficient. Did not treat catalog repetition of '14' as three signals. Did not promote E3/E4 rows. Every surviving claim states its strongest caveat.

surviving_claims.strongest_caveat: Definition 1 is verbatim and load-bearing as a DEFINITION, not as a measured agent-run rate. Transferring it onto live model+web is REFUTED.
Both sources are CI-style varied-environment rebuilds, not independent community rebuilders; the presentation itself warns that a CI percentage is not a rebuild-from-snapshot percentage.
The '30+' figure is a method parameter (how many knobs were twisted), not a detection-rate against a baseline of known uncontrolled inputs.
Catches undeclared fetches; does not make the live model deterministic and does not by itself pin WebSearch results.
Named as impossible, not as a failed attempt. A closed software build without live APIs can still satisfy Definition 1.

reviewer.insufficient_evidence_rule: Missing baseline, E3 single-source, or E4 inference => REFUTED as a promoted mechanism. The 14-test count is E3 motivating case only.
